starterProject.metaTitle: Starter projects — Youth Wetland Research Platform
starterProject.title: Take the first step: observe, record, identify
starterProject.lead: These starter modules help you build field observation, logging, and basic analysis habits—no complex lab gear required.
starterProject.introBody: Start from nearby water and plants, build scientific curiosity, and lay the groundwork for advanced research. Mix and match modules to match your interests and access.

modules.title: Water detectives
modules.body: Use simple test strips and a Secchi disk to log pH, dissolved oxygen, and turbidity—compare sites and seasons.

modules.title: Wetland plant ID
modules.body: Combine field guides with photo ID to build plot records—note dominants, invasives, and indicator species.

modules.title: Microplastics starter
modules.body: Collect surface water along the shoreline, sieve and weigh fractions, and trace likely pollution pathways.

steps: Read safety and ethics guidance; work in the field with an adult volunteer or teacher.
Keep sampling times and transects consistent; use the same log sheet for comparable data.
Photo-archive and back up raw data so you can share with mentors or your community later.
